operator_io_quirks: All identifiers are mixed-case (Manufacturer_ID, Open_Year, Num_of_Factories); must be double-quoted in generated SQL.
DDL uses backtick-quoted parent refs (`manufacturer`) in FK clauses; sqlite_master text must be replayed verbatim.
Tiny tables (7/7/5 rows) — no huge-table sampling path exercised here.
Open_Year declared REAL but semantically a year (1980.0..2000.0); dispatches to Number, not Date.
Market_Rate / Price_in_Dollar REAL with fractional values (52.5, 0.5, 239.0) — Number float path.
furniture_manufacte has composite PK (Manufacturer_ID, Furniture_ID) — both members are FK children too.
FK child columns are also PK members; upstream draws FK values from parent's FINAL filtered column, so PK dedup on parent can shrink the child's value pool.
No NOT NULL, no CHECK, no UNIQUE indexes beyond PKs; all columns nullable in DDL.
No self-references, no dangling FKs, no missing parents — clean FK graph (manufacturer, furniture -> furniture_manufacte).
Storage classes match declared types everywhere (integer/real/text); no contradictions.
Name columns are free text with spaces ('Chevrolet House', 'Billiard table') — String fuzzer will produce charset a-zA-Z 0-9() strings.
Table order: manufacturer, furniture at level 0; furniture_manufacte at level 1.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on Manufacturer_ID/Furniture_ID (int, scale 0): range [-1,1] full, list range [min, max+1] overwritten to full max — fresh draws cluster near 0, perturbed by +-1/+-2.
Number fuzzer on Open_Year (REAL, scale 0): full range [-1,1] — will produce years like 0.3, -0.7, not plausible 1980-2000; likely FN driver for year predicates.
Number fuzzer on Num_of_Factories/Num_of_Shops/Num_of_Component: same [-1,1] range — implausible small/negative counts; FN on '> 20' style predicates.
Number fuzzer on Market_Rate/Price_in_Dollar (REAL): [-1,1] plus perturb +-0.01/+-0.02 — misses 52.5, 239.0, 2124.0 magnitudes; FN on price thresholds.

String fuzzer on Name columns: 5 original samples + pool literals, p=0.2 fresh random over a-zA-Z 0-9() length 0..20, 50% contaminate — will rarely reproduce 'IKEA'/'Chevrolet' exactly; FN on equality, FP on LIKE.
FK fill: furniture_manufacte.Manufacturer_ID drawn from manufacturer.Manufacturer_ID final values (7 distinct, PK-deduped) — ties/duplicates likely, good for join coverage.
Composite PK dedup on furniture_manufacte drops repeated (M_ID, F_ID) pairs — reduces row count below requested n; may under-populate joins.
p=0.2 default, whole-instance p=0 w.p. 0.3 — 30% of instances reuse only pool/original values (no fresh), 70% mix.
max_l0 cap (rng*30) on non-PK columns limits fresh draws — small tables may see heavy reuse of 5 originals.
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforcement in Python; insert failures skipped — but here all columns nullable so few failures expected.
Known misses: FN from implausible Number ranges (years, counts, prices); FP from String contaminate matching LIKE patterns; missing ties unlikely since FK draws with replacement.
